Cintas Corporation Introduces Germ-X to Its Sanitizer Dispenser Line. Cintas Corporation reminds those on the go and without immediate access to soap and water, that hand sanitizer is a viable option. But, not all sanitizers are created equal, which is why Cintas Corporation has partnered with Germ-X to make the well-known consumer brand sanitizer available in all of its rental sanitizer dispensers. Germ-X Advanced hand sanitizer kills more than 99.9% of many common harmful germs and bacteria in as little as 15 seconds. Available through Cintas’ rental service program in both foam and gel formulations, Germ-x’s patented formulations contain 70% alcohol and are CHG, latex, vinyl and nitrile glove-compatible. The sanitizer also contains moisturizers to reduce dryness and leave hands soft.

Cintas Corporation announced that the Company’s Board of Directors approved a $2.55 per share annual dividend at its meeting, representing an increase of 24.4% over last year’s dividend.
